{{Quote|They were first cousins, twice removed. Or was it once removed? It's kind of confusing because my grandfather married his niece&hellip;|Tyrak, on his parents|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
The '''mother''' of [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Tyrak]] was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] member of the [[Tyrak lineage]]. Tyrak's mother [[Marriage/Legends|married]] a [[Tyrak's father|man]] who was also a member of the family&mdash;her first cousin either once or twice removed&mdash;and the two had a son, Tyrak, together. As a result of the incestuous relationships of their family, Tyrak himself was mildly deranged.
